title: Only 7% Can Pass This Vision Test
summary: Spot tiny differences, follow shifting patterns and hold visual details in mind. How much will you catch?

landing.intro:
Tiny details. Big surprises.
How sharp are your eyes?

about.body:
Test your attention with shapes, patterns, colors, reflections and visual snapshots. Each set brings a different kind of puzzle.

Look carefully, then choose the answer supported by what you see. For memory puzzles, study the icons and tap when you are ready to hide them. Your answers build a puzzle score and a breakdown of the areas you handled best.

This is an entertainment challenge, not an eye examination or a medical assessment.

steps: Look at the picture or study the icons, then choose one answer.
At each checkpoint, see your round’s puzzle profile and continue to a new challenge.
Reveal your overall score and explore the answers you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This quiz is not an eye examination and cannot diagnose vision conditions.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your first-look answers put this round in {profile} territory. Next, pick out the signals hiding in a busier display.

next.tagline: A familiar symbol can disappear into a crowd.

stage-2.preAdCopy: This round’s puzzle profile: {profile}. Now see whether you can follow a pattern as it changes.

next.tagline: The next shape is there. Can you see the rule?

stage-3.preAdCopy: Your pattern answers put this round in {profile} territory. Next, the same shapes will turn and flip.

next.tagline: A small turn can change everything.

stage-4.preAdCopy: This round’s puzzle profile: {profile}. Next, trade angles for shades and look for a closer match.

next.tagline: Similar colors. Small differences. A fresh challenge.

stage-5.preAdCopy: Your color answers put this round in {profile} territory. Next, take a snapshot and see what stays with you.

next.tagline: The icons will disappear. Which details will stick?

stage-6.preAdCopy: This round’s puzzle profile: {profile}. Next, inspect codes where a single character can change the answer.

next.tagline: An exact match is harder than a quick glance.

stage-7.preAdCopy: Your code answers put this round in {profile} territory. Next, look inside shapes for hidden structure.

next.tagline: The small shapes count. So do the big ones.

stage-8.preAdCopy: This round’s puzzle profile: {profile}. Next, test your eye against some especially close comparisons.

next.tagline: Look for the detail that changes the whole picture.

stage-9.preAdCopy: Your comparison answers put this round in {profile} territory. Now bring those skills together in a mixed challenge.

next.tagline: A few familiar ideas are about to take a new turn.

stage-10.preAdCopy: Did you beat 80%? Your score and strengths are ready.

profile-1.title: The Eagle Eye
profile-1.copy: You caught the vast majority of the differences, patterns and visual details in this challenge. Your puzzle score reflects consistently accurate answers across the set.

profile-2.title: The Visual Virtuoso
profile-2.copy: You cleared the 80% challenge. Your answers picked out most of the patterns, comparisons and small visual changes in this set.

profile-3.title: The Pattern Spotter
profile-3.copy: You found many of the visual rules and details in this set. Your breakdown shows which puzzle areas you handled most accurately.

profile-4.title: The Detail Detective
profile-4.copy: You spotted plenty of details across different puzzle types. Your breakdown highlights the areas where your answers were strongest.

profile-5.title: The Focus Finder
profile-5.copy: You found some useful clues and solved a mix of visual puzzles. The answer review lets you revisit the comparisons that caught you out.

profile-6.title: The Curious Observer
profile-6.copy: This set gave you plenty of details to sort through. Explore the answer review to see which patterns and changes you missed. This score does not measure your eyesight.
